### Taxonomic Composition by Study, Cultivar and Stage

```{r taxa-strips-by-study}
# Replaces the six circle-packing bubble charts (phylum/family/genus x seeds/seedlings).
# One merged figure per rank: every study stacked in a single column, each strip one
# cultivar x stage. Pooling all samples made the composition mostly a description of
# PRJEB45079 (72% of samples); per-study strips show whether a seed-to-seedling shift is
# general or one study's result - and here it is not consistent across studies.
#
# Abundance is the MEAN OF PER-SAMPLE relative abundances, so each sample carries equal
# weight regardless of sequencing depth.
build_taxa_strips <- function(ps, rank_col, rank_name, threshold, figures_dir, tables_dir) {
    # npg first (goes to the most abundant taxa), then the IGV palette, which is built
    # for many categories - the threshold can expose 50+ genera.
    many <- unique(c(c("#3C5488", "#E64B35", "#00A087", "#E6A700", "#6A3D9A", "#4DBBD5", "#7E6148", "#1B7837", "#D95F02", "#2166AC", "#E7298A", "#66A61E", "#8C510A", "#01665E"), ggsci::pal_igv("default")(51)))
    font <- "Helvetica"

    sd_df <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame"); sd_df$sample_id <- rownames(sd_df)
    tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
    if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)

    # Zero-count samples have no composition; left in they pull strip means below 100%.
    depth <- colSums(otu)
    otu <- otu[, depth > 0, drop = FALSE]; depth <- depth[depth > 0]
    rel <- sweep(otu, 2, depth, "/")

    rank_of <- tax[[rank_col]]
    rank_of[is.na(rank_of) | rank_of == "" | stringr::str_detect(rank_of, "^unassigned")] <- "Unassigned"
    agg <- rowsum(rel, group = rank_of)

    long <- as.data.frame(as.table(agg), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
        setNames(c("Taxon", "sample_id", "rel")) |>
        dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(sd_df, sample_id, study_alias, Author,
                                       Cultivar, Developmental_Stage), by = "sample_id") |>
        # PRJNA649549 records no cultivar at all; dropping blanks removed the study.
        dplyr::mutate(Cultivar = ifelse(is.na(Cultivar) | Cultivar == "", "not reported", Cultivar))

    # THRESHOLD RULE: a taxon is shown if its mean relative abundance reaches
    # `threshold` in AT LEAST ONE strip (study x cultivar x stage); everything else is
    # "Other". Ranking by global abundance instead hid taxa that dominate a single
    # study - e.g. Acidobacteriota at ~45% in alfalfa seeds.
    strip_means <- long |>
        dplyr::summarise(m = mean(rel), .by = c(study_alias, Cultivar, Developmental_Stage, Taxon))
    keep <- strip_means |>
        dplyr::filter(Taxon != "Unassigned") |>
        dplyr::summarise(mx = max(m), overall = mean(m), .by = Taxon) |>
        dplyr::filter(mx >= threshold) |>
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(overall)) |> dplyr::pull(Taxon)

    ref_of <- sd_df |>
        dplyr::mutate(ref = {
            a <- as.character(Author); bad <- !validUTF8(a)
            a[bad] <- iconv(a[bad], from = "macroman", to = "UTF-8")   # file is Mac Roman
            s <- stringr::str_replace(a, "^([^_]+).*", "\\1")
            y <- stringr::str_extract(a, "(19|20)\\d{2}")
            ifelse(is.na(y), s, paste0(s, " et al. ", y))
        }) |>
        dplyr::summarise(ref = paste(sort(unique(ref)), collapse = "; "), .by = study_alias)

    grp <- long |>
        # Unassigned reads are unknown, not rare - keep them as their own category
        # rather than inflating "Other".
        dplyr::mutate(Taxon = dplyr::case_when(Taxon %in% keep ~ Taxon,
                                               Taxon == "Unassigned" ~ "Unassigned",
                                               .default = "Other")) |>
        dplyr::summarise(rel = sum(rel), .by = c(sample_id, study_alias, Cultivar,
                                                 Developmental_Stage, Taxon)) |>
        dplyr::summarise(rel = mean(rel), n = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_id),
                         .by = c(study_alias, Cultivar, Developmental_Stage, Taxon)) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
            Taxon = factor(Taxon, levels = c(keep, "Other", "Unassigned")),
            # Full stage words: truncating to 4 characters made "Seeds" and "Seedlings"
            # identical, collapsing both stages onto one row at 200%.
            Stage = factor(ifelse(Developmental_Stage == "Seeds", "Seed", "Seedling"),
                           levels = c("Seed", "Seedling")),
            # row_key keeps cultivar AND stage so the two stages stay on separate rows;
            # row_lab is what is printed - the stage is shown by shape, not text.
            # Must include the study: "undefined|Seedling" occurs in three studies, and a
            # study-less key made them share one label, printing the wrong n on each.
            row_key = paste(study_alias, Cultivar, Stage, sep = "|"),
            row_lab = sprintf("%s (n=%d)%s", Cultivar, n, ifelse(n < 3, " *", ""))) |>
        dplyr::left_join(ref_of, by = "study_alias") |>
        dplyr::mutate(study_lab = paste0(study_alias, "\n", ref))

    totals <- grp |> dplyr::summarise(tot = sum(rel), .by = c(study_alias, row_key))
    if (any(abs(totals$tot - 1) > 0.02)) {
        stop("taxa strips: a strip does not sum to 100% - duplicate row labels?")
    }

    study_order <- grp |>
        dplyr::distinct(study_lab, row_lab, n) |>
        dplyr::summarise(n = sum(n), .by = study_lab) |>
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) |> dplyr::pull(study_lab)
    grp$study_lab <- factor(grp$study_lab, levels = study_order)

    pal <- setNames(rep(many, length.out = length(keep)), keep)
    pal[["Other"]] <- "#9E9E9E"
    pal[["Unassigned"]] <- "#DDDDDD"
    # Genus names include long SILVA group labels (e.g. Burkholderia-Caballeronia-
    # Paraburkholderia) that clipped at 4+ legend columns.
    legend_cols <- c(phylum = 5, family = 4, genus = 3)[[rank_name]]
    n_legend_rows <- ceiling((length(keep) + 2) / legend_cols)
    n_strips <- dplyr::n_distinct(paste(grp$study_alias, grp$row_key))

    # Cultivar then stage, so each cultivar's seed and seedling strips sit together.
    key_levels <- grp |> dplyr::distinct(row_key, Cultivar, Stage) |>
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Cultivar), dplyr::desc(Stage)) |> dplyr::pull(row_key)
    grp$row_key <- factor(grp$row_key, levels = unique(key_levels))
    lab_map <- grp |> dplyr::distinct(row_key, row_lab)
    lab_map <- setNames(lab_map$row_lab, as.character(lab_map$row_key))
    markers <- grp |> dplyr::distinct(study_lab, row_key, Stage)

    p <- ggplot(grp, aes(x = rel, y = row_key, fill = Taxon)) +
        geom_col(width = 0.78, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2,
                 position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
        # Stage marker just left of each strip: circle = seed, triangle = seedling.
        geom_point(data = markers, aes(x = -0.022, y = row_key, shape = Stage),
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.3, colour = "grey10") +
        scale_shape_manual(values = c(Seed = 16, Seedling = 17), name = NULL) +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(k) lab_map[k]) +
        coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
        facet_grid(rows = vars(study_lab), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
        scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                           expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.01)), position = "top") +
        labs(x = "Mean relative abundance", y = NULL) +
        guides(shape = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.2)),
               fill = guide_legend(order = 2, ncol = legend_cols, byrow = TRUE,
                                   keywidth = unit(11, "pt"), keyheight = unit(11, "pt"))) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = font) +
        theme(strip.placement = "outside",
              strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
              strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 9.5,
                                               family = font, margin = margin(2, 6, 2, 6)),
              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "grey10"),
              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "grey30"),
              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10.5, colour = "grey20"),
              axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
              panel.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"),
              legend.position = "bottom",
              legend.box = "vertical",
              legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "grey15"),
              plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

    out <- file.path(figures_dir, sprintf("fig_taxa_strips_%s.tiff", rank_name))
    ggsave(out, p, width = 12, height = 2.2 + 0.24 * n_strips + 0.2 * n_legend_rows, dpi = 300,
           compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
    readr::write_csv(dplyr::select(grp, study_alias, ref, Cultivar, Stage,
                                   n, Taxon, rel),
                     file.path(tables_dir, sprintf("taxa_strips_%s.csv", rank_name)))
    print(p)
    list(status = "completed", file = out, strips = n_strips, taxa = length(keep),
         low_n = sum(dplyr::distinct(grp, study_alias, row_key, n)$n < 3))
}

strip_threshold <- get_config_value(c("taxonomy_analysis", "strip_other_threshold"), 0.03)
taxa_strip_results <- list(
    phylum = build_taxa_strips(ps, "Phyla",  "phylum", strip_threshold, figures_dir, tables_dir),
    family = build_taxa_strips(ps, "Family", "family", strip_threshold, figures_dir, tables_dir),
    genus  = build_taxa_strips(ps, "Genus",  "genus",  strip_threshold, figures_dir, tables_dir)
)
for (nm in names(taxa_strip_results)) {
    r <- taxa_strip_results[[nm]]
    cat(sprintf("  taxa strips %-7s %s | %d taxa >= %.0f%% in a strip | %d strips (%d with n < 3)\n",
                nm, r$status, r$taxa, 100 * strip_threshold, r$strips, r$low_n))
}

# Register the strip figures' legends alongside Figure 1 and rewrite the legends file,
# so figure_legends.md always matches what this render produced.
if (exists("write_figure_legends")) {
    if (!exists("FIGURE_LEGENDS")) FIGURE_LEGENDS <- list()
    ts <- taxa_strip_results
    FIGURE_LEGENDS[["Figure 2"]] <- list(
        file = sprintf("figures/fig_taxa_strips_%s.tiff", c("phylum", "family", "genus")),
        title = paste("Taxonomic composition of seed and seedling microbiota by study,",
                      "cultivar and developmental stage."),
        panels = c(
            a = sprintf("Phylum level (%d phyla shown).", ts$phylum$taxa),
            b = sprintf("Family level (%d families shown).", ts$family$taxa),
            c = sprintf("Genus level (%d genera shown).", ts$genus$taxa)),
        footer = paste(
            "Each horizontal bar is one cultivar at one developmental stage within a study;",
            "studies are grouped in rows labelled by BioProject and reference, ordered by",
            "number of samples. Bar segments give the mean of per-sample relative abundances,",
            "so every sample carries equal weight. Circles mark seed and triangles seedling",
            "samples; n is the number of samples and * marks bars based on fewer than three.",
            sprintf("Taxa reaching at least %.0f%% mean relative abundance in at least one bar",
                    100 * strip_threshold),
            "are shown individually; all others are pooled as Other, and reads without an",
            "assignment at that rank are shown as Unassigned. Samples with no reads after",
            "filtering are excluded. Panels a-c are supplied as separate files.")
    )
    write_figure_legends(FIGURE_LEGENDS, file.path(tables_dir, "figure_legends.md"))
    cat("  Figure legends updated with Figure 2 (taxonomic strips)\n")
}
```

### Top 5 Genus Correlation Stats by Developmental Stage

```{r top-5-genus-correlation-stats}
if (!all(c("Scientific_Name", "Developmental_Stage") %in% colnames(metadata_df))) {
    cat("Skipping genus correlation stats: required metadata columns are missing.\n")
} else {
    genus_rel <- sweep(genus_matrix, 1, rowSums(genus_matrix), "/")
    genus_rel[is.na(genus_rel)] <- 0

    top5_genera <- colMeans(genus_rel) |>
        sort(decreasing = TRUE) |>
        head(5) |>
        names()

    genus_stage_df <- as.data.frame(genus_rel[, top5_genera, drop = FALSE])
    genus_stage_df$sample_id <- rownames(genus_rel)

    family_lookup <- family_map |>
        dplyr::distinct(Scientific_Name, Family)

    metadata_join_cols <- intersect(c("Scientific_Name", "Developmental_Stage", "Cultivar"), colnames(metadata_df))
    metadata_join_df <- tibble::tibble(sample_id = rownames(metadata_df)) |>
        dplyr::bind_cols(metadata_df[, metadata_join_cols, drop = FALSE])
    if (!"Cultivar" %in% colnames(metadata_join_df)) {
        metadata_join_df$Cultivar <- NA_character_
    }

    genus_stage_df <- genus_stage_df |>
        dplyr::left_join(metadata_join_df, by = "sample_id") |>
        dplyr::left_join(family_lookup, by = "Scientific_Name") |>
        dplyr::mutate(
            Family = dplyr::coalesce(Family, "Other"),
            Cultivar = dplyr::na_if(trimws(as.character(Cultivar)), ""),
            Developmental_Stage = factor(Developmental_Stage, levels = c("Seeds", "Seedlings")),
            stage_binary = dplyr::if_else(Developmental_Stage == "Seedlings", 1, 0, missing = NA_real_)
        )

    top_genus_correlation_stats <- function(df, group_var, min_n = 4) {
        group_sym <- rlang::sym(group_var)

        df |>
            dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(stage_binary)) |>
            dplyr::group_by(!!group_sym) |>
            dplyr::group_modify(function(.x, .g) {
                if (dplyr::n_distinct(.x$Developmental_Stage, na.rm = TRUE) < 2 || nrow(.x) < min_n) {
                    return(tibble::tibble())
                }

                purrr::map_dfr(top5_genera, function(genus_name) {
                    genus_vals <- .x[[genus_name]]
                    keep <- is.finite(genus_vals) & is.finite(.x$stage_binary)
                    genus_vals <- genus_vals[keep]
                    stage_vals <- .x$stage_binary[keep]

                    if (length(genus_vals) < min_n || dplyr::n_distinct(stage_vals) < 2) {
                        return(tibble::tibble())
                    }

                    ct <- suppressWarnings(
                        stats::cor.test(stage_vals, genus_vals, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
                    )

                    seed_mean <- mean(genus_vals[stage_vals == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
                    seedling_mean <- mean(genus_vals[stage_vals == 1], na.rm = TRUE)

                    tibble::tibble(
                        group_type = group_var,
                        group_value = as.character(.g[[1]]),
                        genus = genus_name,
                        n_samples = length(genus_vals),
                        n_seeds = sum(stage_vals == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                        n_seedlings = sum(stage_vals == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                        seed_mean = seed_mean,
                        seedling_mean = seedling_mean,
                        delta_mean = seedling_mean - seed_mean,
                        spearman_rho = unname(ct$estimate),
                        p_value = ct$p.value
                    )
                })
            }) |>
            dplyr::ungroup() |>
            dplyr::mutate(
                p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
            ) |>
            dplyr::arrange(p_adj, dplyr::desc(abs(spearman_rho)))
    }

    family_stats <- top_genus_correlation_stats(genus_stage_df, "Family")
    cultivar_stats <- top_genus_correlation_stats(genus_stage_df, "Cultivar")

    readr::write_csv(family_stats, file.path(tables_dir, "top5_genus_stage_correlation_by_family.csv"))
    readr::write_csv(cultivar_stats, file.path(tables_dir, "top5_genus_stage_correlation_by_cultivar.csv"))
    readr::write_csv(
        tibble::tibble(top5_genera = top5_genera, rank = seq_along(top5_genera)),
        file.path(tables_dir, "top5_genera_used_for_stage_correlations.csv")
    )

    cat("Top 5 genera used for correlations:", paste(top5_genera, collapse = ", "), "\n")

    if (nrow(family_stats) > 0) {
        cat("\n**Family-level Spearman correlations between top 5 genera and developmental stage**\n\n")
        print(knitr::kable(
            utils::head(family_stats, 50),
            digits = 4,
            caption = "Top 5 Genus vs Developmental Stage Correlations by Plant Family"
        ))
    }

    if (nrow(cultivar_stats) > 0) {
        cat("\n**Cultivar-level Spearman correlations between top 5 genera and developmental stage**\n\n")
        print(knitr::kable(
            utils::head(cultivar_stats, 50),
            digits = 4,
            caption = "Top 5 Genus vs Developmental Stage Correlations by Cultivar"
        ))
    }

    plot_top5_genus_stage_correlations <- function(stats_df, group_label, output_dir) {
        if (nrow(stats_df) == 0) {
            cat("Skipping", group_label, "correlation heatmap: no rows.\n")
            return(invisible(NULL))
        }

        plot_df <- stats_df |>
            dplyr::mutate(
                group_value = factor(group_value, levels = unique(group_value)),
                genus = factor(genus, levels = top5_genera),
                label = ifelse(
                    p_adj < 0.05,
                    sprintf("%.2f*", spearman_rho),
                    sprintf("%.2f", spearman_rho)
                )
            )

        p_corr <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = genus, y = group_value, fill = spearman_rho)) +
            geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
            geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 2.4, fontface = "bold") +
            scale_fill_gradient2(
                low = "#0B3D91",
                mid = "white",
                high = "#F94144",
                midpoint = 0,
                limits = c(-1, 1),
                oob = scales::squish,
                name = "Spearman\nrho"
            ) +
            labs(
                x = "Top 5 dominant genera",
                y = group_label,
                title = paste0("Top 5 genus correlations by ", group_label, " and developmental stage"),
                subtitle = "Tiles show Spearman rho; asterisk indicates BH-adjusted p < 0.05"
            ) +
            theme_pipeline_classic() +
            theme(
                axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
                axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
                legend.position = "right"
            )

        safe_group <- tolower(group_label)
        safe_group <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", safe_group)
        safe_group <- gsub("^_|_$", "", safe_group)

        save_nature_figure(
            file.path(figures_dir, paste0("top5_genus_stage_correlation_heatmap_by_", safe_group, ".tiff")),
            p_corr,
            kind = "wide"
        )
    }

    plot_top5_genus_stage_correlations(family_stats, "Plant family", figures_dir)
    plot_top5_genus_stage_correlations(cultivar_stats, "Cultivar", figures_dir)
}
```

## Core Microbiome Analysis

```{r core-microbiome}
compute_core_microbiome <- function(ps, detection = 0.1, prevalence = 0.75,
                                     group_col = NULL, output_dir, tables_dir) {
    tryCatch({
        # ── 1. Global core taxa (all samples) ──────────────────────────────
        bac_core <- microbiome::core(ps,
                                     detection = detection,
                                     prevalence = prevalence,
                                     include.lowest = FALSE)
        bac_ctaxa <- taxa_names(bac_core)

        cat("\n=== Core Microbiome (All Samples) ===\n")
        cat("Core taxa (detection =", detection, ", prevalence =", prevalence, "):",
            length(bac_ctaxa), "\n")

        # ── 2. Per-sample prevalence & mean relative abundance ─────────────
        meta_df <- microbiome::meta(ps)
        asv <- otu_table(ps)
        taxo <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)), "ASV")

        # Presence-absence
        asv_pa <- 1 * ((asv > 0) == 1)

        # Occupancy (prevalence as fraction)
        asv_prev <- rowSums(asv_pa) / ncol(asv_pa)

        # Mean relative abundance (proportion)
        asv_rel <- apply(vegan::decostand(asv, method = "total", MARGIN = 2), 1, mean)

        # Combine into table
        asv_prev_rel <- tibble::rownames_to_column(
            as.data.frame(cbind(asv_prev, asv_rel)), "ASV")
        colnames(asv_prev_rel)[2:3] <- c("prevalence", "mean_rel_abundance")

        # Merge with taxonomy
        asv_prev_rel_taxo <- merge(taxo, asv_prev_rel, by = "ASV")

        # Classify: Core vs Flexible
        asv_prev_rel_taxo <- asv_prev_rel_taxo |>
            dplyr::mutate(
                classification = ifelse(ASV %in% bac_ctaxa, "Core", "Flexible")
            )

        # ── 3. Per-group core taxa (if grouping variable provided) ─────────
        group_core_list <- list()
        if (!is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
            categories <- unique(na.omit(sample_data(ps)[[group_col]]))
            categories <- categories[nchar(categories) > 0]

            for (item in categories) {
                cat("  Identifying core taxa for", item, "...\n")
                bh.subset <- subset_samples(ps, get(group_col) == item)
                bh.subset <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(bh.subset) > 0, bh.subset)

                if (nsamples(bh.subset) >= 3) {
                    subset.core <- microbiome::core_members(bh.subset,
                                                            detection = detection,
                                                            prevalence = prevalence,
                                                            include.lowest = TRUE)
                    group_core_list[[item]] <- subset.core
                    cat("    No. of core taxa in", item, ":", length(subset.core), "\n")
                }
            }
        }

        # ── 4. Save full core microbiome table ─────────────────────────────
        # Convert percentages for output
        asv_prev_rel_taxo_out <- asv_prev_rel_taxo |>
            dplyr::mutate(
                prevalence_pct = prevalence * 100,
                mean_rel_abundance_pct = mean_rel_abundance * 100
            ) |>
            dplyr::arrange(desc(prevalence), desc(mean_rel_abundance))

        write.csv(asv_prev_rel_taxo_out,
                  file.path(tables_dir, "core_microbiome.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

        # ── 5. Scatter plot: Prevalence vs Relative Abundance (Fig 4B Style) ──────
        color_core <- c("Core" = "#ce232a", "Flexible" = "#918bc0")

        # Count taxa per category
        counts_df <- asv_prev_rel_taxo |>
            dplyr::count(classification, name = "n_taxa")

        # Core taxa labels for repelling
        core_for_label <- asv_prev_rel_taxo |>
            dplyr::filter(classification == "Core")

        p_scatter <- ggplot(asv_prev_rel_taxo,
                            aes(x = mean_rel_abundance, y = prevalence * 100)) +
            geom_point(aes(color = classification), size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
            geom_text_repel(
                data = core_for_label,
                aes(label = ASV, color = classification),
                size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 30, show.legend = FALSE
            ) +
            geom_text(
                data = counts_df |> dplyr::filter(classification == "Core"),
                aes(x = 1e-4, y = 10, label = paste0("Core Taxa: ", n_taxa), fontface = "bold"),
                size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
            ) +
            # Abundance-Occupancy Relationship thresholds
            geom_hline(yintercept = prevalence * 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
            geom_vline(xintercept = detection, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
            scale_x_log10(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.001)) +
            scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 101)) +
            scale_color_manual(values = color_core) +
            labs(
                x = "Mean Relative Abundance [%] (log-scale)",
                y = "Occupancy / Prevalence [%]",
                color = "Core Classification",
                title = "Abundance-Occupancy Plot"
            ) +
            theme_pipeline_occupancy() +
            theme(legend.position = "right")

        save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "core_microbiome_abundance_occupancy.tiff"),
                           p_scatter, kind = "standard")

        # ── 6. Stacked bar: Core vs Flexible proportion ────────────────────
        df_bar <- asv_prev_rel_taxo |>
            dplyr::group_by(classification) |>
            dplyr::summarise(
                n_taxa = dplyr::n(),
                rel_ab = sum(mean_rel_abundance * 100),
                .groups = "drop"
            ) |>
            dplyr::mutate(
                classification = factor(classification, levels = c("Flexible", "Core"))
            )

        color_bar <- c("Core" = "#ce232a", "Flexible" = "#918bc0")

        p_bar <- ggplot(df_bar,
                        aes(x = "", y = rel_ab, fill = classification)) +
            geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.25) +
            geom_text(
                aes(label = n_taxa, fontface = "bold", colour = classification),
                position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4
            ) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = color_bar) +
            scale_color_manual(values = c("Core" = "white", "Flexible" = "white")) +
            coord_flip() +
            labs(
                x = NULL,
                y = "Total Relative Abundance [%]",
                fill = "",
                title = "Core vs Flexible Taxa"
            ) +
            theme_pipeline_classic() +
            theme(
                axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                legend.position = "bottom"
            )

        save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "core_microbiome_bar.tiff"),
                           p_bar, kind = "compact")

        # ── 7. Per-group core scatter plots (if grouping variable) ─────────
        if (length(group_core_list) > 0) {
            for (grp_name in names(group_core_list)) {
                grp_ctaxa <- group_core_list[[grp_name]]
                grp_df <- asv_prev_rel_taxo |>
                    dplyr::mutate(
                        grp_core = ifelse(ASV %in% grp_ctaxa, "Core", "Flexible"),
                        grp_core = factor(grp_core, levels = c("Flexible", "Core"))
                    )

                grp_counts <- grp_df |> dplyr::count(grp_core, name = "n_taxa")
                grp_core_label <- grp_df |> dplyr::filter(grp_core == "Core")

                p_grp <- ggplot(grp_df,
                                aes(x = mean_rel_abundance * 100, y = prevalence * 100)) +
                    geom_point(aes(color = grp_core), size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
                    geom_text_repel(
                        data = grp_core_label,
                        aes(label = ASV, color = grp_core),
                        size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = FALSE
                    ) +
                    geom_hline(yintercept = prevalence * 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
                    geom_vline(xintercept = detection, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
                    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(10, 1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001),
                                  labels = c(10, 1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001)) +
                    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 101)) +
                    scale_color_manual(values = color_core) +
                    labs(
                        x = "Relative abundance [%]",
                        y = "Prevalence [%]",
                        color = "",
                        title = paste0(grp_name, " (n = ", length(grp_ctaxa), " core taxa)")
                    ) +
                    theme_pipeline_occupancy() +
                    theme(legend.position = "none")

                ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("core_microbiome_",
                                                     make.names(grp_name), ".tiff")),
                       p_grp, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
            }
        }

        # ── 8. Summary table of core taxa ──────────────────────────────────
        core_summary <- asv_prev_rel_taxo_out |>
            dplyr::filter(classification == "Core") |>
            dplyr::arrange(desc(prevalence_pct), desc(mean_rel_abundance_pct))

        if (nrow(core_summary) > 0) {
            readr::write_csv(core_summary,
                             file.path(tables_dir, "core_taxa_list.csv"))
            knitr::kable(head(core_summary, 20),
                         caption = paste0("Core Taxa (Top 20 of ", nrow(core_summary), ")"))
        }

        list(status = "completed", n_core = length(bac_ctaxa),
             n_groups = length(group_core_list))
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("Core microbiome error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

cat("Computing core microbiome (seed microbiome meta-analysis abundance-occupancy approach)...\n")
# Use thresholds from analysis_config.json (seed microbiome meta-analysis uses 50% prevalence, 0.1% abundance)
core_prev <- config$taxonomy_analysis$core_prevalence_threshold
if (is.null(core_prev)) core_prev <- 0.5

core_det <- config$taxonomy_analysis$core_abundance_threshold
if (is.null(core_det)) core_det <- 0.001

core_result <- compute_core_microbiome(ps, detection = core_det, prevalence = core_prev,
                                        group_col = group_col,
                                        output_dir = figures_dir, tables_dir = tables_dir)
cat("  Core microbiome:", core_result$status, "\n")
if (core_result$status == "completed") {
    cat("  Core taxa:", core_result$n_core, "\n")
    cat("  Group-level analyses:", core_result$n_groups, "\n")
}
```

## Indicator Species Analysis

```{r indicator-species}
perform_indicator_species <- function(ps, group_col, output_dir, tables_dir) {
    if (is.null(group_col) || !(group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps)))) {
        cat("Indicator species: skipped — no grouping variable\n")
        return(list(status = "skipped_no_group"))
    }

    tryCatch({
        meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
        keep <- !is.na(meta_df[[group_col]])
        ps_sub <- prune_samples(keep, ps)
        meta_sub <- meta_df[keep, , drop = FALSE]

        otu <- as(otu_table(ps_sub), "matrix")
        if (taxa_are_rows(ps_sub)) otu <- t(otu)

        # Convert to relative abundance for indicator analysis
        rel_abund <- sweep(otu, 1, rowSums(otu), "/")
        rel_abund[is.na(rel_abund)] <- 0

        # Multipatt: indicator value analysis
        set.seed(123)
        indval_result <- indicspecies::multipatt(
            rel_abund,
            meta_sub[[group_col]],
            func = "IndVal.g",
            control = how(nperm = 999)
        )

        # Extract significant indicators (p < 0.05) via $sign slot
        indval_summary <- as.data.frame(indval_result$sign)
        sig_indicators <- indval_summary[which(!is.na(indval_summary$p.value) & indval_summary$p.value < 0.05), ]
        # Derive a single group label: the group combination with indicator value = 1
        group_cols <- grep("^s\\.", colnames(sig_indicators), value = TRUE)
        if (length(group_cols) > 0) {
            sig_indicators$group <- apply(sig_indicators[, group_cols, drop = FALSE], 1,
                                          function(x) paste(sub("^s\\.", "", group_cols[x == 1]), collapse = "+"))
        } else {
            sig_indicators$group <- "unknown"
        }
        sig_indicators$stat <- indval_result$sign[rownames(sig_indicators), "stat"]

        cat("\n=== Indicator Species Results ===\n")
        cat("Total significant indicators (p < 0.05):", nrow(sig_indicators), "\n")

        if (nrow(sig_indicators) > 0) {
            # Add taxonomy information
            tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_sub), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
            sig_indicators$taxon_id <- rownames(sig_indicators)

            if ("Genus" %in% colnames(tax_df)) {
                sig_indicators$genus <- tax_df[sig_indicators$taxon_id, "Genus"]
                sig_indicators$genus[is.na(sig_indicators$genus) | sig_indicators$genus == ""] <-
                    sig_indicators$taxon_id
            } else {
                sig_indicators$genus <- sig_indicators$taxon_id
            }

            # Save full results
            write.csv(sig_indicators,
                      file.path(tables_dir, "indicator_species_significant.csv"),
                      row.names = FALSE)

            # Plot top indicators
            top_n <- min(20, nrow(sig_indicators))
            top_ind <- sig_indicators[order(sig_indicators$stat, decreasing = TRUE)[1:top_n], ]

            p <- ggplot(top_ind,
                        aes(x = reorder(genus, stat), y = stat, fill = group)) +
                geom_col() +
                coord_flip() +
                scale_fill_manual(values = get_palette(length(unique(top_ind$group)),
                                                       "wildagain", "alpha_diversity")) +
                labs(
                    x = "Indicator Taxon",
                    y = "Indicator Value (IndVal.g)",
                    fill = "Group",
                    title = paste0("Top ", top_n, " Indicator Species")
                ) +
                theme_pipeline_classic() +
                theme(legend.position = "bottom")

            save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "indicator_species_plot.tiff"),
                               p, kind = "standard")

            # Also run phi coefficient analysis
            set.seed(123)
            phi_result <- indicspecies::multipatt(
                rel_abund,
                meta_sub[[group_col]],
                func = "r.g",
                control = how(nperm = 999)
            )
            phi_summary <- as.data.frame(phi_result$sign)
            sig_phi <- phi_summary[which(!is.na(phi_summary$p.value) & phi_summary$p.value < 0.05), ]

            if (nrow(sig_phi) > 0) {
                write.csv(sig_phi,
                          file.path(tables_dir, "indicator_species_phi.csv"),
                          row.names = FALSE)
                cat("Significant phi indicators:", nrow(sig_phi), "\n")
            }
        }

        list(status = "completed", n_indicators = nrow(sig_indicators))
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("Indicator species error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

cat("Running indicator species analysis...\n")
if (!is.null(group_col)) {
    indicator_result <- perform_indicator_species(ps, group_col, figures_dir, tables_dir)
    cat("  Indicator species:", indicator_result$status, "\n")
    if (indicator_result$status == "completed") {
        cat("  Significant indicators:", indicator_result$n_indicators, "\n")
    }
}
```

## Analysis Results

### Alpha Diversity Analysis (wild-again Figure1.Rmd + seedling_meta_analysis integration)

#### Diversity Metrics Calculation

```{r alpha-diversity}
compute_alpha_diversity <- function(ps, counts_matrix, tree, group_col = NULL, output_dir, tables_dir) {
    # Calculate alpha diversity metrics using phyloseq
    richness <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(
        ps,
        measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Fisher")
    )

    # Calculate Evenness (from seedling_meta_analysis.qmd)
    richness$Evenness <- ifelse(
        richness$Observed > 1,
        richness$Shannon / log(richness$Observed),
        NA_real_
    )

    # Calculate Faith's PD (phylogenetic diversity)
    pd_results <- NULL
    if (!is.null(tree) && !is.null(phy_tree(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
        tryCatch({
            otu_for_pd <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
            if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu_for_pd <- t(otu_for_pd)
            pd_results <- picante::pd(otu_for_pd, tree, include.root = FALSE)
            richness$Faith_PD <- pd_results$PD[match(rownames(richness), rownames(pd_results))]
            richness$Phylogenetic_Richness <- pd_results$SR[match(rownames(richness), rownames(pd_results))]
        }, error = function(e) {
            message("Warning: Could not calculate Faith's PD: ", conditionMessage(e))
        })
    }

    # Add metadata if group column specified
    if (!is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
        alpha_df <- cbind(as.data.frame(sample_data(ps)), richness)

        # Check normality
        cat("\n=== Normality Tests ===\n")
        cat("Observed ASV Richness:\n")
        print(shapiro.test(richness$Observed))
        cat("\nShannon Index:\n")
        print(shapiro.test(richness$Shannon))

        # Non-parametric test (Kruskal-Wallis)
        if (length(unique(alpha_df[[group_col]])) > 1) {
            kt_obs <- kruskal.test(Observed ~ get(group_col), alpha_df)
            kt_sh <- kruskal.test(Shannon ~ get(group_col), alpha_df)

            cat("\n=== Kruskal-Wallis Tests ===\n")
            cat("Observed ~", group_col, ":", kt_obs$p.value, "\n")
            cat("Shannon ~", group_col, ":", kt_sh$p.value, "\n")

            # Pairwise comparisons
            wt_obs <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
                alpha_df$Observed,
                as.factor(alpha_df[[group_col]]),
                p.adjust.method = "bonf"
            )

            wt_sh <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
                alpha_df$Shannon,
                as.factor(alpha_df[[group_col]]),
                p.adjust.method = "bonf"
            )

            # Save pairwise comparisons
            saveRDS(wt_obs, file.path(output_dir, "pairwise_observed.rds"))
            saveRDS(wt_sh, file.path(output_dir, "pairwise_shannon.rds"))
        }
    }

    # Save alpha diversity table
    write.csv(richness, file.path(tables_dir, "alpha_diversity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    # Summary statistics
    metrics_to_summarize <- c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Fisher", "Evenness")
    if (!is.null(richness$Faith_PD)) {
        metrics_to_summarize <- c(metrics_to_summarize, "Faith_PD", "Phylogenetic_Richness")
    }

    summary_stats <- data.frame(
        Metric = metrics_to_summarize,
        Mean = vapply(richness[, metrics_to_summarize, drop = FALSE], mean, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = vapply(richness[, metrics_to_summarize, drop = FALSE], median, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = vapply(richness[, metrics_to_summarize, drop = FALSE], sd, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR = vapply(richness[, metrics_to_summarize, drop = FALSE], IQR, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(tables_dir, "alpha_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    knitr::kable(summary_stats, caption = "Alpha Diversity Summary Statistics")

    list(status = "completed", n_samples = nrow(richness), alpha_df = richness)
}

# Determine primary grouping variable from config
group_col <- config$analysis$primary_group
if (!is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
    cat("Computing alpha diversity grouped by:", group_col, "\n")
    alpha_result <- compute_alpha_diversity(ps, counts, phylo_tree, group_col, diversity_dir, tables_dir)
} else {
    cat("Computing alpha diversity (no grouping variable)\n")
    alpha_result <- compute_alpha_diversity(ps, counts, phylo_tree, NULL, diversity_dir, tables_dir)
}
cat("  Alpha diversity:", alpha_result$status, "\n")
```

#### Alpha Diversity Visualization

```{r alpha-diversity-plots}
plot_alpha_diversity <- function(ps, group_col, output_dir) {
    if (is.null(group_col) || !(group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps)))) {
        return(list(status = "skipped_no_group"))
    }

    rich <- estimate_richness(ps, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon"))
    meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
    alpha_df <- cbind(meta_df, rich)
    alpha_df <- alpha_df[!is.na(alpha_df[[group_col]]), , drop = FALSE]

    stats_res <- alpha_group_stats(alpha_df, group_col)
    observed_p <- if (!is.null(stats_res)) stats_res$observed$p.value else NA_real_
    shannon_p <- if (!is.null(stats_res)) stats_res$shannon$p.value else NA_real_
    observed_pairwise <- alpha_pairwise_comparisons(alpha_df$Observed, alpha_df[[group_col]])
    shannon_pairwise <- alpha_pairwise_comparisons(alpha_df$Shannon, alpha_df[[group_col]])

    # Get unique groups for palette
    groups <- unique(sample_data(ps)[[group_col]])
    n_groups <- length(groups[!is.na(groups)])

    # Color palette
    palette <- get_palette(n_groups, "wildagain", "alpha_diversity")

    # Observed ASV richness plot
    p_obs <- plot_richness(ps, x = group_col, measures = "Observed") +
        geom_boxplot(aes(fill = get(group_col)), alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
        geom_jitter(aes(color = get(group_col)), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.95, width = 0.2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = palette, name = group_col) +
        scale_color_manual(values = palette, name = group_col) +
        labs(x = group_col, y = "Observed ASV Richness",
             title = "Observed ASV Richness",
             subtitle = paste("Kruskal-Wallis", format_p_label(observed_p))) +
        theme_pipeline_classic() +
        theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "bottom"
        )

    # Shannon diversity plot
    p_sh <- plot_richness(ps, x = group_col, measures = "Shannon") +
        geom_boxplot(aes(fill = get(group_col)), alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
        geom_jitter(aes(color = get(group_col)), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.95, width = 0.2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = palette, name = group_col) +
        scale_color_manual(values = palette, name = group_col) +
        labs(x = group_col, y = "Shannon Diversity Index",
             title = "Shannon Diversity",
             subtitle = paste("Kruskal-Wallis", format_p_label(shannon_p))) +
        theme_pipeline_classic() +
        theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "bottom"
        )

    # Save individual plots
    save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "alpha_observed.tiff"), p_obs, kind = "standard")
    save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "alpha_shannon.tiff"), p_sh, kind = "standard")

    # Combined plot (multi-panel with cowplot)
    legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_obs)
    p_obs_nl <- p_obs + theme(legend.position = "none")
    p_sh_nl <- p_sh + theme(legend.position = "none")
    p_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(
        cowplot::plot_grid(p_obs_nl, p_sh_nl, labels = c("A", "B"), nrow = 1, label_size = 15),
        legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1)
    )
    save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "alpha_combined.tiff"), p_combined, kind = "wide")

    if (!is.null(observed_pairwise)) {
        saveRDS(observed_pairwise, file.path(output_dir, "pairwise_observed.rds"))
    }
    if (!is.null(shannon_pairwise)) {
        saveRDS(shannon_pairwise, file.path(output_dir, "pairwise_shannon.rds"))
    }

    # ── Faceted richness by plant species ───────────
    if ("Scientific_Name" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps)) &&
        "study_alias" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {

        meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
        # Compute median richness per species for ordering
        rich <- estimate_richness(ps, measures = "Observed")
        meta_df$observed_otus <- rich$Observed

        # Order species by median richness
        species_medians <- tapply(meta_df$observed_otus, meta_df$Scientific_Name, median, na.rm = TRUE)
        meta_df$Scientific_Name <- factor(meta_df$Scientific_Name,
                                           levels = names(sort(species_medians)))
        meta_df$study_alias <- as.character(meta_df$study_alias)
        if ("Developmental_Stage" %in% colnames(meta_df)) {
            meta_df$Developmental_Stage <- factor(meta_df$Developmental_Stage, levels = c("Seeds", "Seedlings"))
        }

        p_species <- ggplot(meta_df,
                            aes(x = observed_otus, y = study_alias,
                                color = Scientific_Name)) +
            geom_jitter(alpha = 0.95, size = 1.5) +
            geom_vline(
                data = data.frame(
                    Scientific_Name = factor(names(species_medians), levels = levels(meta_df$Scientific_Name)),
                    median_val = as.numeric(species_medians)
                ),
                aes(xintercept = median_val),
                linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"
            ) +
            facet_grid(Scientific_Name ~ Developmental_Stage, scales = "free", space = "free") +
            scale_x_log10() +
            labs(x = "Observed ASV Richness", y = "Studies",
                 title = "Bacterial ASV Richness by Plant Species",
                 subtitle = paste("Observed richness plotted; species medians shown by vertical lines")) +
            theme_pipeline_faceted() +
            theme(
                strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0, face = "bold.italic"),
                legend.position = "none"
            ) +
            guides(col = guide_legend(ncol = 4))

        save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "alpha_richness_by_species.tiff"),
                           p_species, kind = "wide")
    }

    if ("Cultivar" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps)) &&
        "study_alias" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {

        meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
        rich <- estimate_richness(ps, measures = "Observed")
        meta_df$observed_otus <- rich$Observed
        meta_df$Cultivar <- trimws(as.character(meta_df$Cultivar))
        meta_df$Cultivar[meta_df$Cultivar == ""] <- NA_character_
        meta_df <- meta_df[!is.na(meta_df$Cultivar), , drop = FALSE]

        if (nrow(meta_df) > 0) {
            cultivar_medians <- tapply(meta_df$observed_otus, meta_df$Cultivar, median, na.rm = TRUE)
            meta_df$Cultivar <- factor(meta_df$Cultivar,
                                       levels = names(sort(cultivar_medians)))
            meta_df$study_alias <- as.character(meta_df$study_alias)
            if ("Developmental_Stage" %in% colnames(meta_df)) {
                meta_df$Developmental_Stage <- factor(meta_df$Developmental_Stage, levels = c("Seeds", "Seedlings"))
            }

            p_cultivar <- ggplot(meta_df,
                                 aes(x = observed_otus, y = study_alias,
                                     color = Cultivar)) +
                geom_jitter(alpha = 0.95, size = 1.5) +
                geom_vline(
                    data = data.frame(
                        Cultivar = factor(names(cultivar_medians), levels = levels(meta_df$Cultivar)),
                        median_val = as.numeric(cultivar_medians)
                    ),
                    aes(xintercept = median_val),
                    linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"
                ) +
                facet_grid(Cultivar ~ Developmental_Stage, scales = "free", space = "free") +
                scale_x_log10() +
                labs(x = "Observed ASV Richness", y = "Studies",
                     title = "Bacterial ASV Richness by Cultivar",
                     subtitle = paste("Observed richness plotted; cultivar medians shown by vertical lines")) +
                theme_pipeline_faceted() +
                theme(
                    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0, face = "bold.italic"),
                    legend.position = "none"
                ) +
                guides(col = guide_legend(ncol = 4))

            save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "alpha_richness_by_cultivar.tiff"),
                               p_cultivar, kind = "wide")
        }
    }

    list(status = "completed")
}

if (!is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
    cat("Plotting alpha diversity...\n")
    alpha_plot_result <- plot_alpha_diversity(ps, group_col, figures_dir)
    cat("  Alpha diversity plots:", alpha_plot_result$status, "\n")
}
```

### Rarefied Alpha Diversity

```{r rarefied-alpha}
compute_rarefied_alpha <- function(ps, rarefaction_depth = NULL, group_col = NULL,
                                    output_dir, tables_dir) {
    tryCatch({
        otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
        if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)

        # Determine rarefaction depth: minimum sample sum or specified depth
        min_depth <- min(rowSums(otu))
        if (is.null(rarefaction_depth)) {
            rarefaction_depth <- min_depth
        } else {
            rarefaction_depth <- min(rarefaction_depth, min_depth)
        }

        cat("Rarefying to depth:", rarefaction_depth, "\n")

        # Rarefy all samples to the same depth
        set.seed(123)
        otu_rarefied <- t(apply(otu, 1, function(x) {
            rrarefy(x, sample = rarefaction_depth)
        }))
        rownames(otu_rarefied) <- rownames(otu)

        # Calculate alpha diversity on rarefied data
        richness_rarefied <- rowSums(otu_rarefied > 0)
        shannon_rarefied <- diversity(otu_rarefied, index = "shannon")
        simpson_rarefied <- diversity(otu_rarefied, index = "simpson")

        rarefied_df <- data.frame(
            sample_id = rownames(otu_rarefied),
            Observed_rarefied = richness_rarefied,
            Shannon_rarefied = shannon_rarefied,
            Simpson_rarefied = simpson_rarefied,
            rarefaction_depth = rarefaction_depth,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )

        # Add metadata
        if (!is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
            meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
            rarefied_df <- merge(rarefied_df, meta_df,
                                 by.x = "sample_id", by.y = "row.names", all.x = TRUE)

            # Statistical tests on rarefied data
            if (length(unique(rarefied_df[[group_col]])) > 1) {
                kt_obs_r <- kruskal.test(Observed_rarefied ~ get(group_col), rarefied_df)
                kt_sh_r <- kruskal.test(Shannon_rarefied ~ get(group_col), rarefied_df)

                cat("\n=== Rarefied Alpha Diversity: Kruskal-Wallis Tests ===\n")
                cat("Observed (rarefied) ~", group_col, ":", kt_obs_r$p.value, "\n")
                cat("Shannon (rarefied) ~", group_col, ":", kt_sh_r$p.value, "\n")
            }

            # Plot rarefied observed richness
            pal_r <- get_palette(length(unique(rarefied_df[[group_col]])),
                                "wildagain", "alpha_diversity")

            p_obs_r <- ggplot(rarefied_df,
                              aes(x = .data[[group_col]], y = Observed_rarefied,
                                  fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
                geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
                geom_jitter(aes(color = .data[[group_col]]),
                            width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.95) +
                scale_fill_manual(values = pal_r) +
                scale_color_manual(values = pal_r) +
                labs(
                    x = group_col,
                    y = "Observed ASV Richness (rarefied)",
                    title = paste0("Rarefied ASV Richness (depth = ", rarefaction_depth, ")")
                ) +
                theme_pipeline_classic() +
                theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                      legend.position = "none")

            save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "rarefied_observed.tiff"),
                               p_obs_r, kind = "standard")

            # Plot rarefied Shannon
            p_sh_r <- ggplot(rarefied_df,
                             aes(x = .data[[group_col]], y = Shannon_rarefied,
                                 fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
                geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
                geom_jitter(aes(color = .data[[group_col]]),
                            width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.95) +
                scale_fill_manual(values = pal_r) +
                scale_color_manual(values = pal_r) +
                labs(
                    x = group_col,
                    y = "Shannon Index (rarefied)",
                    title = paste0("Rarefied Shannon Diversity (depth = ", rarefaction_depth, ")")
                ) +
                theme_pipeline_classic() +
                theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                      legend.position = "none")

            save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "rarefied_shannon.tiff"),
                               p_sh_r, kind = "standard")
        }

        write.csv(rarefied_df, file.path(tables_dir, "rarefied_alpha_diversity.csv"),
                  row.names = FALSE)

        list(status = "completed", rarefaction_depth = rarefaction_depth,
             n_samples = nrow(rarefied_df))
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("Rarefied alpha error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

cat("Computing rarefied alpha diversity...\n")
# Ensure rarefaction depth is 500 as per user instructions (respected from config)
rare_depth <- config$filters$min_library_size
if (is.null(rare_depth)) rare_depth <- 500

rarefied_alpha_result <- compute_rarefied_alpha(ps, rarefaction_depth = rare_depth,
                                                 group_col = group_col,
                                                 figures_dir, tables_dir)
cat("  Rarefied alpha:", rarefied_alpha_result$status, "\n")
if (rarefied_alpha_result$status == "completed") {
    cat("  Rarefaction depth:", rarefied_alpha_result$rarefaction_depth, "\n")
}
```

### Faith's Phylogenetic Diversity

```{r faiths-pd}
compute_faiths_pd <- function(ps, output_path) {
    if (is.null(phy_tree(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
        return(list(status = "skipped_no_tree"))
    }
    
    tryCatch({
        otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
        if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
        tree <- phy_tree(ps)
        
        pd_result <- pd(otu, tree, include.root = FALSE)
        pd_df <- data.frame(
            sample_id = rownames(pd_result),
            faith_pd = pd_result$PD,
            phylogenetic_richness = pd_result$SR,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        
        write.csv(pd_df, output_path, row.names = FALSE)
        list(status = "completed", n_samples = nrow(pd_df))
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("Faith's PD error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

faith_pd_result <- compute_faiths_pd(ps, file.path(diversity_dir, "faith_pd.csv"))
```

### Beta Diversity Analysis (wild-again Figure2.Rmd approach)

#### UniFrac Distances

```{r unifrac}
compute_unifrac <- function(ps, output_dir) {
    if (is.null(phy_tree(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
        return(list(status = "skipped_no_tree"))
    }

    tryCatch({
        start_parallel_cluster()

        # Unweighted UniFrac
        uw <- get_beta_distance(ps, "unifrac", output_dir)

        # Weighted UniFrac
        w <- get_beta_distance(ps, "wunifrac", output_dir)

        # Full CSV distance matrices are optional because as.matrix() can double
        # memory for large sample sets. RDS preserves the compact dist object.
        write_distance_matrix_csv(uw, file.path(output_dir, "unifrac_unweighted_distance.csv"))
        write_distance_matrix_csv(w, file.path(output_dir, "unifrac_weighted_distance.csv"))

        list(status = "completed", n_samples = nsamples(ps))
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("UniFrac error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

cat("  UniFrac:", unifrac_result$status, "\n")
```

#### PERMANOVA (adonis2)

```{r permanova}
subset_beta_to_stages <- function(ps, stages = c("Seeds", "Seedlings")) {
    if (!"Developmental_Stage" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
        return(ps)
    }
    meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
    keep <- !is.na(meta_df$Developmental_Stage) & meta_df$Developmental_Stage %in% stages
    ps_sub <- prune_samples(keep, ps)
    prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)
}

perform_permanova <- function(ps, group_col, output_dir, tables_dir) {
    if (is.null(group_col) || !(group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps)))) {
        cat("PERMANOVA: skipped — no grouping variable\n")
        return(list(status = "skipped_no_group"))
    }

    tryCatch({
        meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
        # Filter out NAs in grouping variable
        keep <- !is.na(meta_df[[group_col]])
        ps_sub <- prune_samples(keep, ps)
        meta_sub <- meta_df[keep, , drop = FALSE]

        # Bray-Curtis distance; reused across PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, NMDS, and PCoA.
        dist_bc <- get_beta_distance(ps_sub, "bray", output_dir)

        # PERMANOVA with config-driven permutations
        n_perm <- config$analysis$permutations
        if (is.null(n_perm)) n_perm <- 999
        set.seed(123)
        permanova_result <- vegan::adonis2(
            dist_bc ~ get(group_col),
            data = meta_sub,
            permutations = n_perm,
            parallel = parallel_config$n_threads
        )

        cat("\n=== PERMANOVA Results ===\n")
        print(permanova_result)

        # Save results
        write.csv(as.data.frame(permanova_result),
                  file.path(tables_dir, "permanova_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

        list(status = "completed", result = permanova_result)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("PERMANOVA error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

perform_permanova_stage_subset <- function(ps, group_col, output_dir, tables_dir) {
    ps_stage <- subset_beta_to_stages(ps)
    if (nsamples(ps_stage) < 4) {
        return(list(status = "skipped_too_few_samples"))
    }
    result <- perform_permanova(ps_stage, group_col, output_dir, tables_dir)
    if (identical(result$status, "completed")) {
        dest <- file.path(tables_dir, "permanova_results_stage_subset.csv")
        if (file.exists(dest)) file.remove(dest)
        file.rename(
            file.path(tables_dir, "permanova_results.csv"),
            dest
        )
    }
    result
}

cat("Running PERMANOVA...\n")
permanova_result <- list(status = "not_run")
permanova_stage_result <- list(status = "not_run")
if (!is.null(group_col)) {
    permanova_result <- perform_permanova(ps_beta, group_col, diversity_dir, tables_dir)
    cat("  PERMANOVA:", permanova_result$status, "\n")
    permanova_stage_result <- perform_permanova_stage_subset(ps_beta, group_col, diversity_dir, tables_dir)
    cat("  PERMANOVA (stage subset):", permanova_stage_result$status, "\n")
}
```

#### PERMDISP (betadisper)

```{r permdisp}
perform_permdisp <- function(ps, group_col, output_dir, tables_dir) {
    if (is.null(group_col) || !(group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps)))) {
        cat("PERMDISP: skipped — no grouping variable\n")
        return(list(status = "skipped_no_group"))
    }

    tryCatch({
        meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
        keep <- !is.na(meta_df[[group_col]])
        ps_sub <- prune_samples(keep, ps)
        meta_sub <- meta_df[keep, , drop = FALSE]

        dist_bc <- get_beta_distance(ps_sub, "bray", tables_dir)

        # Test homogeneity of dispersions
        n_perm <- config$analysis$permutations
        if (is.null(n_perm)) n_perm <- 999
        set.seed(123)
        disp_result <- vegan::betadisper(dist_bc, meta_sub[[group_col]])
        disp_test <- vegan::permutest(disp_result, permutations = n_perm,
                                      parallel = parallel_config$n_threads)

        cat("\n=== PERMDISP Results ===\n")
        print(disp_test)

        # Save results
        disp_df <- data.frame(
            sample_id = rownames(meta_sub),
            group = meta_sub[[group_col]],
            distance_to_centroid = disp_result$distances,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        write.csv(disp_df, file.path(tables_dir, "permdisp_distances.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

        # Plot
        pal_disp <- get_palette(length(unique(disp_df$group)), "wildagain", "alpha_diversity")
        p <- ggplot(disp_df, aes(x = group, y = distance_to_centroid, fill = group)) +
            geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
            geom_jitter(aes(color = group), width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.95) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = pal_disp) +
            scale_color_manual(values = pal_disp) +
            labs(
                x = group_col,
                y = "Distance to Group Centroid",
                title = "PERMDISP: Homogeneity of Group Dispersions"
            ) +
            theme_pipeline_classic() +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

        save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "permdisp_plot.tiff"), p, kind = "standard")

        list(status = "completed", test = disp_test)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("PERMDISP error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

perform_permdisp_stage_subset <- function(ps, group_col, output_dir, tables_dir) {
    ps_stage <- subset_beta_to_stages(ps)
    if (nsamples(ps_stage) < 4) {
        return(list(status = "skipped_too_few_samples"))
    }
    result <- perform_permdisp(ps_stage, group_col, output_dir, tables_dir)
    if (identical(result$status, "completed")) {
        dest <- file.path(tables_dir, "permdisp_distances_stage_subset.csv")
        if (file.exists(dest)) file.remove(dest)
        file.rename(
            file.path(tables_dir, "permdisp_distances.csv"),
            dest
        )
    }
    result
}

permdisp_stage_result <- list(status = "not_run")

}
```

#### NMDS Ordination

```{r nmds}
compute_nmds <- function(ps, group_col = NULL, output_dir) {
    tryCatch({
        dist_bc <- get_beta_distance(ps, "bray", output_dir)

        # NMDS with 2 dimensions, try multiple starts
        set.seed(123)
        nmds_result <- metaMDS(dist_bc, k = 2, try = 50, trymax = 100, trace = 0)

        # Extract scores
        scores_df <- data.frame(
            Sample = rownames(nmds_result$points),
            NMDS1 = nmds_result$points[, 1],
            NMDS2 = nmds_result$points[, 2],
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )

        # Add metadata
        if (!is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
            meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
            scores_df <- merge(scores_df, meta_df, by.x = "Sample", by.y = "row.names", all.x = TRUE)
        }

        # Stress value
        stress <- nmds_result$stress
        cat("NMDS stress:", round(stress, 3), "\n")

        # Plot
        p <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = .data[[group_col]])) +
            geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.95) +
            labs(
                x = "NMDS1",
                y = "NMDS2",
                color = group_col,
                title = paste0("NMDS Ordination (Stress = ", round(stress, 3), ")")
            ) +
            theme_pipeline_classic() +
            theme(legend.position = "right") +
            guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

        # Save
        save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, "nmds_plot.tiff"), p, kind = "standard")
        write.csv(scores_df, file.path(output_dir, "nmds_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

        # Shepard diagram
        shepard <- Shepard(dist_bc, nmds_result$points)
        p_shep <- plot(shepard, type = "p", pch = 16, cex = 0.7,
                       main = "Shepard Diagram", xlab = "Observed Dissimilarity",
                       ylab = "Ordination Distance")
        ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "nmds_shepard.tiff"),
               recordPlot(), width = 6.5, height = 5.0, dpi = 300)

        list(status = "completed", stress = stress)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("NMDS error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

cat("Computing NMDS ordination...\n")
nmds_result <- compute_nmds(ps_beta, group_col, diversity_dir)
cat("  NMDS:", nmds_result$status, "\n")
```

#### PCoA Ordination

```{r pcoa}
compute_pcoa <- function(ps, distance_method, output_dir) {
    tryCatch({
        # Calculate distance matrix
        if (distance_method %in% c("unifrac", "wunifrac")) {
            if (is.null(phy_tree(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
                return(list(status = "skipped_no_tree"))
            }
            dist_mat <- get_beta_distance(ps, distance_method, output_dir)
        } else if (distance_method == "bray") {
            dist_mat <- get_beta_distance(ps, "bray", output_dir)
        } else if (distance_method == "jaccard") {
            dist_mat <- get_beta_distance(ps, "jaccard", output_dir)
        } else {
            dist_mat <- get_beta_distance(ps, distance_method, output_dir)
        }

        # PCoA
        pcoa_result <- cmdscale(dist_mat, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

        # Extract variance explained
        var_explained <- round(pcoa_result$eig / sum(pcoa_result$eig) * 100, 2)

        # Create data frame for plotting
        pcoa_df <- data.frame(
            Sample = rownames(pcoa_result$points),
            PCoA1 = pcoa_result$points[, 1],
            PCoA2 = pcoa_result$points[, 2],
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )

        # Add metadata
        if (!is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
            meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
            pcoa_df <- merge(pcoa_df, meta_df, by.x = "Sample", by.y = "row.names", all.x = TRUE)
        } else {
            return(list(status = "skipped_no_group"))
        }

        # ── 1. Create a plot with color = Scientific_Name and shape = Developmental_Stage (Beta Diversity) ──
        if ("Scientific_Name" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps)) && "Developmental_Stage" %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
            p_spec <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2,
                                          color = Scientific_Name,
                                          shape = Developmental_Stage)) +
                geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.95) +
                scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 16, 2, 3)) +
                labs(
                    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
                    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"),
                    color = "Plant Species", shape = "Stage",
                    title = paste0("PCoA (", distance_method, ")")
                ) +
                theme_pipeline_classic() +
                theme(
                    legend.position = "right",
                    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic")
                ) +
                guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, order = 1),
                       shape = guide_legend(ncol = 1, order = 2))
            save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, paste0("pcoa_", distance_method, "_species.tiff")),
                               p_spec, kind = "wide")
        }

        # ── 2. Standard PCoA plot using primary group ──
        p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = .data[[group_col]])) +
            geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.95) +
            labs(
                x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
                y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"),
                color = group_col,
                title = paste0("PCoA (", distance_method, ")")
            ) +
            theme_pipeline_classic() +
            theme(legend.position = "right") +
            guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

        # Save standard PCoA
        save_nature_figure(file.path(output_dir, paste0("pcoa_", distance_method, ".tiff")),
                           p, kind = "standard")
        write.csv(pcoa_df, file.path(output_dir, paste0("pcoa_", distance_method, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

        list(status = "completed", var_explained = var_explained)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("PCoA error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

compute_pcoa_rank <- function(ps, distance_method, output_dir, suffix, title_suffix) {
    tryCatch({
        if (distance_method %in% c("unifrac", "wunifrac")) {
            if (is.null(phy_tree(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
                return(list(status = "skipped_no_tree"))
            }
            dist_mat <- get_beta_distance(ps, distance_method, output_dir)
        } else {
            dist_mat <- get_beta_distance(ps, distance_method, output_dir)
        }

        pcoa_result <- cmdscale(dist_mat, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
        var_explained <- round(pcoa_result$eig / sum(pcoa_result$eig) * 100, 2)
        pcoa_df <- data.frame(
            Sample = rownames(pcoa_result$points),
            PCoA1 = pcoa_result$points[, 1],
            PCoA2 = pcoa_result$points[, 2],
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )

        if (!is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% colnames(sample_data(ps))) {
            meta_df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))
        pcoa_df <- merge(pcoa_df, meta_df, by.x = "Sample", by.y = "row.names", all.x = TRUE)
        }

        p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = .data[[group_col]])) +
            geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.95) +
            labs(
                x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
                y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"),
                color = group_col,
                title = paste0("PCoA (", distance_method, ") ", title_suffix)
            ) +
            theme_pipeline_classic() +
            theme(legend.position = "right") +
            guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

        save_nature_figure(
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("pcoa_", distance_method, "_", suffix, ".tiff")),
            p, kind = "standard"
        )
        write.csv(
            pcoa_df,
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("pcoa_", distance_method, "_", suffix, ".csv")),
            row.names = FALSE
        )

        list(status = "completed", var_explained = var_explained)
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("PCoA rank error: ", conditionMessage(e))
        list(status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
}

# Compute PCoA for different distance methods
distance_methods <- c("bray", "jaccard")
if (!is.null(phy_tree(ps_beta, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
    distance_methods <- c(distance_methods, "unifrac", "wunifrac")
}

for (dm in distance_methods) {
    cat("Computing PCoA with", dm, "distance...\n")
    pcoa_result <- compute_pcoa(ps_beta, dm, diversity_dir)
    cat("  PCoA", dm, ":", pcoa_result$status, "\n")
    if (dm %in% c("bray", "jaccard")) {
        cat("Computing PCoA with", dm, "distance at OTUID level...\n")
        pcoa_otuid_result <- compute_pcoa_rank(ps_beta_otuid, dm, diversity_dir, suffix = "otuid", title_suffix = "OTUID level")
        cat("  PCoA", dm, "OTUID:", pcoa_otuid_result$status, "\n")

        cat("Computing PCoA with", dm, "distance at genus level...\n")
        pcoa_genus_result <- compute_pcoa_rank(ps_beta_genus, dm, diversity_dir, suffix = "genus", title_suffix = "Genus level")
        cat("  PCoA", dm, "Genus:", pcoa_genus_result$status, "\n")
    }
}
```
